items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 70:1
items.html: (To the question) Not all the Ibur, Yenika, and Mochin come at once; only the ten Sefirot of Ibur-Yenika come to her at once. And this is because her Ibur is made in the Nukva in the body of ZA, which is considered her root.
